MRL_ft.Footnotes_MRL: There is evidence that 1,4-dimethylnaphthalene could naturally occur in some plant compounds. Based on currently available monitoring data a temporary MRL is set at a value of 0.05 mg/kg pending the submission of further monitoring data to confirm it. When reviewing the MRL, the Commission will take into account the information, if it is submitted by 2 August 2024, or, if that information is not submitted by that date, the lack of it.
